current.text: He is a rookie. He is not listed among the projected Memphis starters (Jerome, Coward, Grant, Boozer, Edey) or the projected bench (Pippen, Wells, Stewart, GG Jackson, Spencer).
The Memphis forward group is crowded, with Boozer starting and Prosper, Hendricks, Edey, Stewart and Grant also in the mix. The roster still needs cuts.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11 or 12 man rotation with short stints and keeps minutes down.
His Summer League was very good, but an expert thinks it overrated him. In dynasty rookie ranks he sits around 20th, and Cameron Carr should probably rank ahead of him.
An expert thinks he probably cannot play alongside Cameron Boozer.
Memphis has a maxed 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks through March 28 and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He was the 21st pick of the 2026 draft. He went to Memphis with Isaiah Stewart in exchange for pick 17.
Experts see him as a solid rotation player without much upside and not a strong rebounder.
He has no clear standout skill. One expert says he cannot really shoot, defend or pass.
